body_es: Amazon Route 53 es el servicio de DNS (Domain Name System) altamente disponible y escalable de AWS. Permite registrar dominios, gestionar zonas DNS y enrutar el tráfico de usuarios globalmente mediante políticas de enrutamiento avanzadas. Las zonas hosted pueden ser públicas (resuelven en Internet) o privadas (resuelven solo dentro de VPCs). Los tipos de registros fundamentales son A (IPv4), AAAA (IPv6), CNAME (alias de nombre), MX (correo), TXT (verificación y SPF) y NS. Los registros Alias de Route 53 son una extensión propietaria que permite apuntar a recursos de AWS (ALB, CloudFront, S3 website) en el apex del dominio, donde los CNAMEs no están permitidos por el estándar DNS. Las políticas de enrutamiento del SAA-C03 son cruciales: Simple (respuesta única), Weighted (distribución porcentual, útil para A/B testing), Latency-Based (dirige al recurso con menor latencia), Geolocation (por país o continente), Geoproximity (por proximidad geográfica con bias ajustable), Multi-Value Answer (múltiples IPs con health checks), y Failover (activo-pasivo). Route 53 Health Checks monitorean endpoints HTTP/HTTPS/TCP y pueden automatizar failover entre regiones. El TTL controla cuánto tiempo los resolvers cachean las respuestas DNS.
body_en: Amazon Route 53 is AWS's highly available, globally distributed DNS service that also provides domain registration and health checking. Hosted zones can be public (Internet-resolvable) or private (resolves only within specified VPCs). Standard record types include A (IPv4), AAAA (IPv6), CNAME (canonical name alias), MX (mail exchange), and TXT (verification). Route 53 Alias Records are a proprietary extension that resolves to AWS resources — ALBs, CloudFront distributions, S3 static websites, API Gateway endpoints — at no extra charge per query and uniquely allow apex domain (zone apex) records, which standard CNAMEs prohibit. Routing policies are heavily tested on SAA-C03: Simple (single value), Weighted (percentage-based split for A/B testing or blue-green deployments), Latency (routes to the AWS Region with lowest measured latency), Geolocation (routes by country or continent for localization or data residency), Geoproximity (geographic routing with a configurable bias that expands or shrinks a region's traffic share), Multi-Value Answer (returns up to 8 healthy records), and Failover (active-passive with health check-based automatic switching). Route 53 Health Checks monitor HTTP, HTTPS, or TCP endpoints and calculated health checks can aggregate multiple child checks for composite failover decisions.
example_code:
# List hosted zones
aws route53 list-hosted-zones

# Create DNS record
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets \
  --hosted-zone-id Z123 \
  --change-batch file://changes.json

# Create health check
aws route53 create-health-check \
  --health-check-config IPAddress=192.0.2.1,Type=HTTP,Port=80
